actor_segment: Actors in a precisely defined relevant state.
existing_commitment: Scarce resource expected to already be moving.
blocking_limitations: Why current options fail under relevant constraints.
transaction_path: How resources can become an actual transaction.
acceptance_boundary: What a viable new option must accomplish.
observable_next_commitment: Specific behavior predicted if demand is real.
falsification_conditions: Observation that would materially weaken or reject the hypothesis.
revalidation_conditions: Environmental change that should trigger revalidation.
canonical_statement: As of the stated date, we hypothesize that the defined actors will commit scarce resources under the stated conditions; this remains falsifiable by the listed conditions.
